profile.headline: Turbine Hot Section Engineering
profile.summary: Actively seeking a full time position in aerospace industry. To contribute my educational background, Fluid Dynamics/ thermal Science experimental experiences , and computer simulation (CFD) skills in aerospace structure/Turbine Machinery design and analysis.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Project Management · Problem Solving · Project Planning · Product Development

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
• Turbine hot section aerodynamic design:
o High/low pressure turbine flow path and airfoil design/analysis for future and existing engine improvements.
o Completed a 2-stage high pressure turbine test rig design and post-test analysis to validate innovative technologies incorporated.
• In-house design tool improvement (efficiency based analysis and loss model)
• Production part conformity validation and process improvement.
• Research and technology development tasks
o HPT work split/rim speed reduction
o HPT rim cavity ingestion
o HPT airfoil advanced cooling design
positions.insights: Skills: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) · Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) · iSight · Ensight · Python (Programming Language) · Project Planning · Computer-Aided Design (CAD)

positions.title: Component Engineer
positions.description:
•Participated in advanced cooling and aero-thermal methodologies development for Siemens next generation gas turbine hot section components.
•Developed an infrared (IR) test facility for traditional and additive manufactured hot section components thermal-fluid properties.
•Characterized newly developed heat transfer features with Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) tools.
•Integrated newly developed heat transfer features into turbine hot section components for Siemens future frames & service upgrades.
•Mentor and oversight Siemens sponsored research projects at selected U.S. universities (UT Austin, and UCF).
•IPT lead for rig testing design and validation at global Siemens Energy laboratories and facilities.
•Siemens Fluid & Heat Transfer review board member for technology review process and scholarly article publication.
positions.insights: Skills: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) · Project Planning · Computer-Aided Design (CAD)

positions.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
positions.description:
Conducting gas turbine internal and external cooling experimental research studies.
Mentoring fresh graduate students.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Achievement: 
Honeywell Aerospace Sponsored Projects (2011~2014)
Turbine Vane Film Cooling Heat Transfer Phenomena Combine Study 
•Transonic wind tunnel, consisted of 5 vane annual cascade design (Ma#1.3). Applied PSP and TSP methods to study transonic HT phenomena and external coolant jet effectiveness on a turbine vane and end wall platform.
Turbine Vane Suction Side Film Cooling Heat Transfer 
•Apply PSP and TSP methods to study HT phenomena and external coolant jet effectiveness on a turbine vane.
Siemens Energy Sponsored Projects (2011~2014)
Advanced Turbine Internal Cooling Testing Program (Export Control Regulations; ECC)
•Experimentally evaluate HT and pressure distribution of modern internal cooling passages under Reynolds number (Re#) 30k~400k.
Heat Transfer in Rotating Blade Modern Internal Coolant Passage at Re# 100k to 200k (ECC)
•Experimentally evaluate HT enhancement factor of four modern internal cooling designs in an engine scale rotating turbine blade test rig.
Heat Transfer in Rotating Blade-Shape Serpentine Coolant Passage with Ribbed Walls at Low Mach Numbers 
•Study HT behavior of internal cooling passages inside an engine scale turbine blade. Hands-on experience on refrigerant & pressurized system.
Solar Turbines Sponsored Projects (2012~2013)
Rotating Cooling Wedge Channel with Slot Ejection in Hub Turn Region 
•Experimentally investigated rib, pin fin, and rotation effects on HT and downstream ejection.
The Influence of Unsteady Wake with Trailing Edge Coolant Ejection on Turbine Blade Film Cooling 
•Studied film cooling effectiveness of unsteady wake with trailing edge coolant ejection on 5 turbine blade linear cascade. 
Department of Energy Sponsored Project (2009~2010)
Endwall Contouring, Leading Edge Filleting and Blade Tip Ejection under Rotating Turbine Conditions 
•High pressure turbine performance and detailed inter-stage parameter measurement. 
•Solid hands-on experience in turbine components assembly/ disassembly and maintenance.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Graduate Teaching Assistant for Class Manufacturing Processes (ENTC181)
•Instructed under-graduation machine shop lab session.

positions.title: R&D/Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Achievement:
Camera Module All in One System -design adopted by Motorola, ASUS, Samsung, and Nokia
•	Developed an auto focusing system by integrating motor control theory with computer visual technology. 
Bluetooth Head Set Mass Production System -invention adopted by Dell
•	Integrated full-auto testing equipment with mechanical audio system, RF Shielding and Electrical Probe. 
Office Document Center Production System-product adopted by Kyocera 
•	Advanced the understanding of anti-static plastic materials and Hi-Pot (up to 7000V) manufacturing equipment. 

Other duties:
•Constructed the mechanical platform and for developing automation equipment required by the production line.
•Liaised between Taipei technical headquarter and China production lines.
•Engaged in personnel training and technical consultation in Mainland China.
positions.insights: Skills: Sheet Metal · Autodesk Inventor · Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing · Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) · Project Planning

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•Completed NTU EV1 project, a joint electric motorcycle project undertaken by Industrial Technology Research Institute and National Taiwan University.
•Completed the test-run of the finished prototype.

projects.title: Rotating Cooling Wedge Channel with Slot Ejection in Hub Turn Region (sponsored by Solar Turbines)
projects.description: Experimentally investigated rib, pin fin, and rotation effects on heat transfer and downstream ejections.

projects.title: Phantom Cooling: The Influence of Unsteady Wake with Trailing Edge Coolant Ejection on Turbine Blade Film Cooling (sponsored by Solar Turbines)
projects.description:
•Investigate unsteady wake effect with trailing edge coolant ejection on turbine blade film cooling effectiveness. 
•Simulated typical engine condition of high density “blade film cooling” and “unsteady wake with trailing edge coolant ejection” on turbine blade film cooling effectiveness.
